name: Ghostbuster Detection
description: Applies Ghostbuster method combining multiple weak signals — structured search over feature combinations (Verma et al., 2023).
mechanism:
The Ghostbuster Detection method implements the technique from Verma et al. (2023) for detecting AI 생성 text using structured search over weaker language models:

1. **Feature벡터Construction**: The input text is processed through a series of weaker, unstructured language models (e.g., unigram, bigram, trigram models and a small GPT-like model). For each token, the probability assigned by each model is computed, yielding per-token probability vectors from multiple model perspectives.

2. **Document-LevelFeatureAggregation**: Token-level probabilities are aggregated into document-level features using selected functions: mean, variance, and quantile statistics of log-probabilities from each model. This creates a compact feature vector capturing the distributional characteristics of the text through multiple linguistic lenses.

3. **StructuredSearchoverFeatureCombinations**: A structured search selects the most discriminative combination of features and models. Rather than relying on a single powerful model, Ghostbuster combines signals from multiple weaker models — exploiting the observation that AI 생성 text exhibits characteristic probability patterns across different model architectures.

4. **Linear분류**: The selected feature vector is fed into a trained logistic regression classifier. The linear model ensures interpretability and robustness — avoiding overfitting to specific generator architectures. The decision boundary separates human-written text (which shows variable probability across models) from AI 생성 text (which tends to be uniformly probable across models).

5. **Confidence점수 산출**: The classifier output probability provides a confidence score. Texts near the decision boundary are flagged as uncertain, while those with strong signals from multiple feature dimensions receive high-confidence predictions. 본 방법은 generalizes across different AI 생성기 without requiring per-model training.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적
